paper_metadata.title: Quantum Implementation of Risk Analysis-relevant Copulas

summary: The paper proposes quantum circuits for sampling financial copulas (notably B11 and MB11 copulas) and demonstrates small prototypes on IBM hardware (2–5 qubits) and symbolic simulations up to 12 qubits. A toy quantum risk‑analysis example estimates VaR for a 2‑factor loss model using 12 simulated qubits (4 copula + 1 comparator + 7 amplitude‑estimation), illustrating the theoretical quadratic speedup of amplitude estimation over Monte Carlo but without empirical advantage.
